dialogue: The race has started. I can't wait to see who'll win.
Allow me to play you a victory song.
You'll choose me? Aww, thanks. You're my dear racer♡
Listen to this intense song and focus.
Going slow is fine, too. It's safer.
Keep going, Commander.
Keep it up! The finish line is in sight!
That's the spirit! Just like that!
Heehee. I knew you'd pull through.
Not bad at all. I thought you'd lose your cool!
What? The record? You did break the top speed record.
Heheh. Can't get enough of my support, can ya?
It might not look like it, but I AM rootin' for ya. Don't get your ass kicked.
Took you a while. Had any technical problems? C'mon, victory's just 'round the corner.
I'm rooting for ya. Just gotta believe in yourself.
Reckon you can set a new record?
I'm cheerin' for ya. Ain't no way you're gonna lose.
Heh! I can already taste the gold trophy.
You're ready for the race. Let's stay in peak condition.
Let us thank the Holy Iris for its blessings. Granted, this was more thanks to your talent, Commander.
Together, let us seize victory once more.
I'm praying for you. Continue onward.
Do you think you should service your car one more time?
Safety first. Let's keep moving forward diligently.
I will judge you based on your placing. Okay, that was a joke. Slow and steady wins the race.
You're getting better. Have the blessings given you new talent?
I saw it. Victory awaits your arrival.
Commander, the camera is ready! Let's film today's track vlog. Three, two, one... Rolling!
Perfect! Don't forget to leave a Like to boost the video!
Whoa! You really know what it means to be the best partner, Commander!
Slow and steady wins the race~ I'll edit this part to be super moody.
Don't rush too much. Safety first, remember?
Just like that, Commander! You look even cooler than usual right now!
Ooh, good pace! The speed and the cheers are perfect!
Go, go, go! All the way to the finish line, Commander!
Wow! This baby accelerates like nothing I've ever seen before!
Hmm... The view is perfect. Let's get ready to go, Commander.
Oh? Already at the goal? Very impressive, Commander.
You're still going? *sigh*... Fine. Switching could be troublesome.
Take it slowly, if you'd like. At least it feels smoother this way...
This speed is on the leisurely side... but that, too, is part of the racing experience.
This pace is just right for me. It's not tiring, but not too lax, either.
Your route is looking good. Keep up this pace, and we should make it to the finish line with ease.
Oh? You're awfully motivated, Commander... Then I'll take this seriously, too.
An impressive pace. Victory shouldn't be far off for long.
Heehee... Let me see your prowess on the track.
Well done. That was an impressive lap. I've noted down your data and routing information.
Heehee, do you want me by your side? If you must have me around, then I will never leave you.
Commander, the key to victory lies beneath a calm bearing.
There's nothing wrong with cautious driving. Victory cannot come without safely reaching the finish line.
Don't lose your rhythm. Press onward!
Very good! Keep it up, and let your engine roar!
Keep up that momentum and carve a path forward.
Heehee, very smooth acceleration. Victory is within reach.
